nodes.summary:
Experimental local JSON protocol companion; reads one request on stdin and writes its response on stdout.
--artifact: producer /2 corpus
--index: embedded indexed artifact
--mode: build, query, or parity (experimental)
--request: query or question recording JSON
--root: source-revalidating producer only
--sha256: required operator-pinned index digest
usage: corvint-corpus-parity [--artifact VALUE] [--index VALUE] [--mode VALUE] [--request VALUE] [--root VALUE] --sha256 VALUE
